cutoff_scope: The cutoff freezes discovery observations and inventory membership only. Classification, replay, consistency review, and receipt validation may occur later and are separately dated; they may not silently add a candidate to this inventory version.

predecessor_inventory.supersession_reason: Two concrete immutable leads observed after the version-1 cutoff were appended and classified in version 2.

phase_boundary: This node may classify a candidate with an explicit trust blocker when a required proof-credit field cannot yet be established. Such a candidate cannot receive M1/M0 or exact-root credit; parser-aware transitive trust closure remains a downstream proof/validation prerequisite.
negative_evidence_policy: Record each dated query, HTTP status, result count or explicit access failure, and response SHA-256. A blocked index is never a negative result. A bounded no-match is never a claim of global absence.
append_only_policy: A concrete candidate observed after this cutoff is not folded into THM-M-0814-anchor-inventory/2. It must be classified under a new successor inventory before any coverage or saturation claim is recomputed.
